decision: No supported new abstractive summary mechanism or model run proposed from this bounded investigation.
one_materially_different_mechanism_consi: An extractive action appendix selected by source passage IDs and rendered only as complete verbatim original passages, with exact source timestamps.
mechanically_useful_property: Once a relevant complete passage is selected, its action wording, locally stated actors, conditions and negation are preserved without paraphrase.
reason_not_advanced: Completeness of action selection and remote context remains unproved; exact source identity does not establish exhaustive action coverage.
The safe source-excerpt representation, action/condition/negation cues, local context grouping and bounded exact-source validation already exist in source_highlights.py.

Both original short summary sources already fall within the existing whole-source excerpt branch; counting full-source excerpts as a successful concise AI summary would change the claim rather than fix the failed summary.
Another freeform action ledger, citation check or revision would retain the semantic gaps exposed by the earlier source-cited and source-first-repair failures.
unchanged_current_summary_decision: English rejected for loss of the specific quotation-with-speaker verification action; Greek unrun and unauthorized; specialist model not approved.

narrow_prompt_fix_retained.scope: Three generic placeholder-removal literals only; not applied to production and not a semantic/model approval.
